checks.name: proof-reuse-behavior
checks.run:
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from factoryline.proof_reuse import proof_key
t = TemporaryDirectory()
r = Path(t.name)
p = r / 'input.txt'
p.write_text('green', encoding='utf-8')
g = {'name': 'unit', 'command': ['python', '-m', 'pytest'], 'inputs': ['input.txt'], 'outputs': [], 'read_only': True, 'toolchain': {'python': '3.11'}, 'environment': {'os': 'smoke'}}
k = proof_key(r, g)
assert len(k) == 64 and k == proof_key(r, g)
p.write_text('changed', encoding='utf-8')
assert proof_key(r, g) != k
